title: Beyond Tokens: Probing Higher-Order Epistasis in Learned Protein Representations
abstract: arXiv:2608.24953v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Protein fitness landscapes contain nonlinear interactions in which mutation effects depend on other residues. We introduce ORBIT, an Order-Resolved Benchmarking of Interaction Transformations framework that separates interaction presence, representation accessibility, and functional recovery. ORBIT first validates Walsh-based diagnostics on synthetic landscapes with known interaction order, then analyzes the experimentally measured GB1 fitness landscape under the FLIP 2-vs-rest setting. We compare ridge regression, a standard MLP, independent tokens, nonlinear independent tokens, and Residual Interaction Tokenization (RIT).   Across 20 paired training seeds, the primary two-hidden-layer comparison found no significant architecture differences in FLIP test R^2, third- or fourth-order functional recovery, or final-layer third- or fourth-order accessibility. translated_title: 超越标记：探测学习蛋白质表示中的高阶上位效应
translated_abstract: 蛋白质适应度景观包含非线性相互作用，其中突变效应依赖于其他残基。我们引入了ORBIT，一种阶次解析的相互作用变换基准框架，该框架将相互作用存在性、表示可访问性和功能恢复分开评估。ORBIT首先在具有已知相互作用阶数的合成景观上验证了基于Walsh的诊断方法，然后在FLIP 2-vs-rest设置下分析了实验测量的GB1适应度景观。我们比较了岭回归、标准MLP、独立标记、非线性独立标记和残差交互标记化（RIT）。在20个配对训练种子中，主要的两隐藏层比较未发现FLIP测试R²、三阶或四阶功能恢复或最终层三阶或四阶可访问性方面的显著架构差异。然而，RIT在标记阶段显著增加了成对可访问性。
tldr: 该论文提出了ORBIT框架，系统评估蛋白质表示中的高阶上位效应，发现不同架构在功能恢复上无显著差异，但RIT方法能增强成对交互的可访问性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ORBIT to systematically probe higher-order epistasis in protein representations, finding no significant architecture differences in functional recovery but showing that RIT enhances pairwise interaction accessibility.
